description: Update the member's own public fee range (GBP, min and max) shown on their profile — the same field as the app's profile editor. Requires the member's "Allow my assistant to act" switch.

max_fee.description: Maximum fee in GBP (must be >= min, capped 100000).

min_fee.description: Minimum fee in GBP (0 or more).

name: set_my_fee_range
title: Set my public fee range
